idea-plugin.name: T3 Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
TYPO3 (v12+) support: a TypoScript language with completion by object type, Fluid templates and components with inline syntax highlighting and completion, labels (XLIFF), TCA and Services.yaml - with navigation in both directions: from a template to its partials, layouts and components, and from a partial, label or PHP class back to everything that uses it.

TypoScript

  • Highlighting, folding, structure view, breadcrumbs, formatter for .typoscript, .tsconfig, setup.txt and constants.txt - parsed like TYPO3 v12+ does. Known properties and numeric keys get their own colours.
  • Completion by object type: page.10. after page.10 = FLUIDTEMPLATE offers templateName, dataProcessing, variables …, also through copies (< lib.content) in other files. Built-in reference for PAGE, CONFIG, content objects, stdWrap, typolink, data processors and TSconfig (mod, TCEFORM, TCEMAIN …), plus every key set in the project. Values: content objects, data processors, constants after {$ (also site settings), functions after :=, condition variables, EXT: paths.
  • Navigation: Cmd/Ctrl-click a path to where it is set (also copy sources), {$constant} to its definition or site setting, userFunc classes and methods, data processors, @import paths with *. Hover shows the property documentation.
  • Checks: unclosed blocks, missing imports, undefined constants, and deprecated <INCLUDE_TYPOSCRIPT: with a quick-fix to @import.

Fluid

  • Partials, layouts and sections: Cmd/Ctrl-click partial="Some/Partial", <f:layout name="…"/> or section="…" (tag and inline syntax). Root paths from TypoScript (partialRootPaths …) are included. Partials and layouts that cannot be found are marked as errors.
  • Fluid Components (fluid_components and Fluid 4 components of TYPO3 v14): completion of component tags (prefixes as you type, <my: lists all components of the namespace and inserts the required parameters), Cmd/Ctrl-click a component tag like <my:molecule.teaser>, parameter completion from <fc:param> / <f:argument> with type and required/optional, warning for missing required parameters. Unknown components are marked as errors. Gutter icon and Navigate | Related Symbol lead to the component files (.fixture.json, Styles, Scripts …). Namespaces registered in ext_localconf.php and ComponentCollection classes are resolved, own component folders can be added in the settings.
  • Usages in the gutter: partials, layouts, templates and components show where they are used - in other templates, partials and TypoScript (EXT: paths, templateName).
  • ViewHelpers: Cmd/Ctrl-click <f:format.html>, {f:count()} or {x -> my:thing()} to open the ViewHelper class, and an attribute or inline argument to jump to its registerArgument(). Namespaces from {namespace}/xmlns, TYPO3 defaults, ext_localconf.php and your own list in Settings | Languages & Frameworks | T3 Toolkit.
  • ViewHelper completion: tags (<f:fo → f:format.html, required arguments inserted) and arguments from registerArgument() with type and description; missing required arguments are marked. Hover a ViewHelper or argument for its documentation.
  • Completion of partial, layout and section names in partial="…", <f:layout name="…"/> and section="…".
  • Icons: Cmd/Ctrl-click and completion for <core:icon identifier="…"/> from Configuration/Icons.php.
  • Variables: Cmd/Ctrl-click {item.title} to jump to where it comes from - f:for as, f:variable, f:alias in the same file, <fc:param> in a component, the f:render arguments that pass it to a partial, or TypoScript (as =, variables.) and PHP (assign(), assignMultiple(), $processedData[]) for templates.
  • Inline syntax: highlighting of {item.title -> f:format.case(mode: 'upper')} (variables, ViewHelpers, arguments, strings, operators), completion of ViewHelpers, arguments and variables (including Extbase assign() and TypoScript variables), documentation of inline arguments, unknown ViewHelpers marked as errors, intentions to switch between inline and tag syntax and to turn HTML comments into <f:comment>.
  • Extbase: a gutter icon leads from listAction() to Templates/<Controller>/List.html and back.
  • EXT: paths are clickable in every file.
  • No more Unresolved file reference for Fluid expressions like href="{f:uri.typolink(…)}".

Labels (XLIFF)

  • Cmd/Ctrl-click LLL:EXT:my_ext/Resources/Private/Language/locallang.xlf:some.key in any file (Fluid, PHP, TCA, TypoScript, YAML, FlexForms) to jump to the <trans-unit>, or the path to open the file. Short keys in <f:translate key="…"/> use the locallang.xlf of extensionName or of the template's extension; also any own translate ViewHelper, LocalizationUtility::translate() and your own ViewHelpers, methods and functions from the settings.
  • Completion of language files after LLL: and of keys (with their text) after .xlf: and in f:translate.
  • Labels are folded in the editor and show their text (click to expand).
  • Missing language files and keys are marked as errors, with a quick-fix Create label that adds the <trans-unit>.
  • In language files: labels missing in a translation (de.locallang.xlf …) or left over in one are marked.
  • Each <trans-unit> shows in the gutter where the label is used.
  • Hover a label to see all its translations; Rename (Shift+F6) changes the key in every language file and usage.

TCA

  • Completion of keys and values in Configuration/TCA (also Overrides, $GLOBALS['TCA'] and addTCAcolumns()): config keys by type, renderType, eval, table names, fields in ctrl, foreign_field and showitem, palettes.
  • Cmd/Ctrl-click foreign_table, foreign_field, MM, ctrl fields and showitem entries to their definition.

Services.yaml

  • Cmd/Ctrl-click classes, @service references, resource/exclude paths and tag methods.
  • PHP classes show in the gutter in which Services.yaml they are registered and how: service with public/tags/arguments, alias, injected into another service, or autodiscovered via resource.
  • Move to PHP attribute (quick-fix): event.listener, console.command, messenger.message_handler and backend.controller tags become #[AsEventListener], #[AsCommand], #[AsMessageHandler] or #[AsController] on the class, the YAML entry is removed. Only offered where the project's TYPO3 version supports the attribute (from composer.lock).

New classes

New | TYPO3 in a PSR-4 folder: event listener, console command, message handler, backend controller, public service and middleware, registered with PHP attributes - or in Services.yaml where the TYPO3 version needs it (e.g. event listeners on v12). Middlewares are added to Configuration/RequestMiddlewares.php. In a components folder: New | TYPO3 | Fluid Component with a parameter table (name, type, optional) and fixture. Anywhere: New | TYPO3 | TypoScript File.

If another TypoScript or Fluid plugin is installed, disable it to avoid file type conflicts and duplicate highlighting. TYPO3 is a registered trademark of the TYPO3 Association; this plugin is not affiliated with it.
